doc: Known nano-vs-Zeebe trace divergences. Each entry: {scenario, issue: "#N", reason, ignoreRecords?, reorderRecords?, nanoTrace?}. A listed scenario that no longer diverges is STALE and fails engine-core/tests/zeebe_traces.rs — delete it. `ignoreRecords` (record-field matchers) narrows the entry: only matching records may differ; every other record of every step must still equal Zeebe. `reorderRecords` ({steps: [i..], match: [matchers]}) tolerates only the ORDER of matching records, only in the listed steps — they are still compared as a multiset. `nanoTrace` (#1521) pins the fingerprint of nano's divergent trace: any change in nano's behaviour on that scenario fails until re-reviewed and re-pinned; generated-budget (g-*) entries must carry it (or ignoreRecords).

entries.reason: Step 0 (createInstance) only: nano runs each parallel-MI child's inner flow depth-first (child 0's whole flow before child 1 activates); Zeebe's worklist is FIFO (MultiInstanceBodyProcessor activates every child, then drains each behaviour), so the children interleave. Both emit the SAME 27 PROCESS_INSTANCE records (verified multiset-equal) — only their order differs. This is a record-ordering/scheduling difference, not a scoping or correctness defect; the variable scoping (#1518, fixed by #1519) and the body-local outputCollection + per-child updates (#1534, rendered by the trace adapter) all match. Narrowed with reorderRecords: only the ORDER of step-0 PROCESS_INSTANCE records may differ (compared as a multiset, so a missing/changed record still fails); every other record and all of steps 1-4 must still equal Zeebe exactly.

interrupting message event sub-process: the interrupted service task `work` is torn down as ELEMENT_COMPLETING/COMPLETED instead of Zeebe's TERMINATING/TERMINATED (same teardown defect as interrupting boundaries, #1535). Narrowed with ignoreRecords to `work`'s lifecycle records only (it has no other lifecycle in the interrupting step); every other record — EVENT_SUB_PROCESS lifecycle, subscription/timer, variables, process completion — must equal Zeebe.

timeCycle repetition count ignored: after the 2nd fire of R2/PT1M nano re-arms a third TIMER CREATED (then CANCELED when the scope completes); Zeebe stops re-arming. Narrowed with ignoreRecords to TIMER CREATED/CANCELED records targeting `esp_start`; every lifecycle record (both EVENT_SUB_PROCESS runs) must equal Zeebe.
